purpose: FINAL PUBLIC EXPERIENCE typography and editorial refinement: unify visible public typography into one local system-font hierarchy, remove sub-12px public microtype, preserve responsive hierarchy and mobile readability, and rewrite public RU/EN/ZH copy to be direct, specific and natural without changing product authority or runtime semantics.
requiredInvariants: Public typography uses only the local system-font stack; no remote font runtime dependency is introduced.
Visible public text in the governed canonical/header/assistant/dock surfaces does not use font sizes below 12 CSS px.
Body/supporting copy remains role-appropriate at 12-17px while headings scale with clamp() and retain a clear H1/H2/body hierarchy.
Mobile readability does not rely on page-level horizontal overflow; existing internal Deal-stage rail behavior remains unchanged.
Public controls retain >=44x44 CSS pixel targets where already required.
RU/EN/ZH copy remains semantically aligned and preserves fail-closed language around unavailable data, server authority, finance, roles and critical actions.
No API, database, Prisma, auth, RBAC, RLS, tenant, Deal state, money, outbox, infra, release authority or production workflow behavior is changed.
Existing accessibility, Lighthouse, CLS, browser, visual-regression, security and production thresholds are not weakened.
No visual baseline or maxDistance threshold may be changed until new screenshots are produced and manually inspected.
acceptance: Exact-head web-unit, Node CI, security, scope guard, canonical visual and Design System v8 acceptance are terminal green.
Typography unit contract proves no governed visible public font size below 12px and no Inter/Georgia/Times New Roman legacy stack remains in governed surfaces.
RU/EN/ZH public copy is reviewed for repetition, generic AI-style phrasing, unnatural symmetry and vague marketing language while preserving factual and authority boundaries.
Mobile production-like screenshots are inspected at 320/375/390/430 and desktop at 1280/1440 before any visual baseline refresh.
No horizontal page overflow, clipped CTA/header copy or reduced touch targets are introduced.
